title: How I Actually Got Into AI (The Real Answer)
description:
People ask how I got into AI. They want a clean origin story.

Truth is I made a choice and decided to make it work.

That's the whole thing.

Some of what I picked makes zero sense to anyone but me. I'm cool with that now.

The older I get, the more I see it. The little things you do every day are what stack up.

Pick one thing. Stay with it.

And if you made a call and you're not sure it was right, just go make it right.
